headers.comment: The Android APK is deployed under a non-.apk extension because Firebase Hosting's Spark (free) plan rejects executable file extensions (.apk included) at deploy time. These headers restore the correct type/filename on download - see frontend/public/downloads/keyshop-app.keeapp.

hosting.comment: Dedicated Hosting site for api.keyshops.in, routing every request to the deployed Firestore backend (backend/src/functions-main.ts, codebase 'api') - keeps the same custom domain the Render deployment used, so the already-built frontend and published Android APK (both with VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://api.keyshops.in baked in at build time) need zero changes for the cutover.
